questions.question: What method initializes objects when created?
questions.explanation: Constructors set up object state during creation.

questions.question: What is the name of a constructor in relation to its class?
questions.explanation: Constructors have the same name as their class.

questions.question: What constructor has no parameters?
questions.explanation: Default constructors require no arguments.

questions.question: What constructor accepts arguments?
questions.explanation: Parameterized constructors allow custom initialization.

questions.question: What constructor creates objects from existing ones?
questions.explanation: Copy constructors duplicate existing objects.

questions.question: What method cleans up resources before object destruction?
questions.explanation: Destructors release resources when objects are destroyed.

questions.question: What symbol precedes destructor names in C++?
questions.explanation: Tilde symbol marks destructors in C++.

questions.question: How many destructors can a class have?
questions.explanation: Classes can have only one destructor.

questions.question: What Python method acts as a constructor?
questions.explanation: The __init__ method initializes Python objects.

questions.question: What Python method acts as a destructor?
questions.explanation: The __del__ method cleans up Python objects.

questions.question: What is the return type of a Java constructor?
questions.explanation: Constructors have no return type, not even void.

questions.question: What keyword creates new objects in Java?
questions.explanation: The new keyword allocates and initializes objects.

questions.question: What happens if you define no constructor in a Java class?
options: The compiler provides a default constructor
questions.explanation: Java inserts a no-arg default constructor automatically.

questions.question: What is constructor overloading?
options: Multiple constructors with different parameter lists
A constructor with too many parameters
questions.explanation: Overloaded constructors offer different parameter signatures.

questions.question: In Python, what is the first parameter of __init__ called?
questions.explanation: Self refers to the instance being initialized.

questions.question: What C++11 constructor transfers resources instead of copying them?
questions.explanation: Move constructors steal resources from temporary objects.

questions.question: What does this() do inside a Java constructor?
options: Calls another constructor in the same class
questions.explanation: This() delegates to another constructor of the same class.

questions.question: What does super() do inside a constructor?
questions.explanation: Super() invokes the superclass constructor.

questions.question: In what order do constructors run in an inheritance chain?
questions.explanation: Parent constructors complete before child constructors begin.

questions.question: What C++ technique ties resource lifetime to object lifetime?
questions.explanation: RAII acquires resources in constructors and releases in destructors.

questions.question: Which statement about C++ destructors is true?
questions.explanation: Destructors accept no parameters and cannot be overloaded.

questions.question: Which language calls destructors deterministically when objects leave scope?
questions.explanation: C++ runs destructors predictably at scope exit.

questions.question: How is a C++ destructor named?
questions.explanation: Destructors use the class name prefixed with a tilde.

questions.question: What Java interface enables automatic cleanup in try-with-resources?
questions.explanation: AutoCloseable resources are closed automatically by try-with-resources.

questions.question: What happens in Java when a constructor throws an exception?
options: A partially created object is returned
questions.explanation: A failed constructor prevents object creation entirely.

questions.question: What C++11 keyword delegates one constructor's work to another?
options: Delegating constructor syntax in the initializer list
questions.explanation: C++11 delegating constructors call sibling constructors in the initializer list.
